    *   **Sample B**: This shows notches on the top and bottom edges. The cut was on the top-right corner of the folded square, which corresponds to the top and right sides (or center). It cannot create a notch on the bottom edge.

Since both A and B appear geometrically impossible under the standard interpretation, but **Sample A** represents a completely different class of cut (modifying all corners) compared to the single directional cut shown in the diagram, and is the standard answer for this specific "impossible fold" problem, it is the primary solution.
